title: Prospective three-seed shared-task run
body: Materialize the hash-checked Zero training and promotion files, encode training through the Solomon byte adapter, train seeds 1, 2, and 3 for exactly four epochs, freeze all model hashes, create blinded promotion inputs, predict once per frozen model, and verify every seed. The shared-task result resolves go only if every seed reaches 950000 operation_exact_rate_ppm. The source result separately records an all-seed agreement gate for the broader Solomon family conclusion.
claims: The promotion outcomes were not observed before this design, its forecasts, and its funding records merged.
Training-only liveness calibration is excluded from the outcome evidence.
